Head tracking from the **Audeze Maxwell 2 ANC** to **OSC** -- the Maxwell
counterpart of NXOSC Reborn, with the same profiles and the same OSC output
for the same head pose.

Unofficial and not affiliated with, endorsed by or supported by Audeze LLC.

### Download

- **macOS** -- `Max2OSC-macOS.zip` (tested)
- **Windows** -- `Max2OSC-Windows.zip` (**untested** -- see below)

Both are standalone; no Python needed. Connect the headset through the USB
dongle (preferred) or its cable before starting.

**macOS.** The app is not signed by an identified developer, so the first
launch is blocked. Open it once, dismiss the warning, then go to System
Settings > Privacy & Security and click **Open Anyway**.

**Windows -- not tested yet.** This build has not been run with a Maxwell 2
ANC on Windows. The code is written to work there, but expect rough edges and
please report what happens. Extract the zip **on the Windows machine** and
keep `Max2OSC.exe` together with the `_internal` folder beside it.
SmartScreen may warn on first run: **More info > Run anyway**.
